description: This file contains shell script code for testing the credential cache functionality in a Git environment. It includes setup logic, test cases for socket location, behavior under different environment variables, and socket handling, among other test procedures.

methods.name: test_path_is_socket
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a socket, with different implementations depending on the platform.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified path exists.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_atexit
methods.description: Ensures cleanup commands are run at script exit.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs specific credential cache tests, e.g., cache, password expiry, OAuth refresh token, auth type.

methods.name: check approve
methods.description: Validates that the output matches expected credential configuration.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables related to cache settings.
